name: managest
description: ManaGest — ERP de gestion pour la Polynésie française

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.ui-tests.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.check:preview: python3 scripts/check-screens.py && python3 scripts/check-c2-e2-h2.py && python3 scripts/check-h1-permission.py && python3 scripts/check-planning-sla.py
scripts.check:preview:hosted: node scripts/check-preview-config.mjs && python3 scripts/check-screens.py && python3 scripts/check-c2-e2-h2.py && python3 scripts/check-h1-permission.py && python3 scripts/check-planning-sla.py
